scope: Compare current official Gemini API terms with the local RAG privacy notice; no project prompt, evidence, key, or user data sent to Google.

claims_checked: Unpaid Gemini API service may use submitted prompts and generated responses to provide, improve, and develop Google products; human reviewers may read, annotate, and process input/output.

Gemini API use through a Google Cloud project with active billing is treated as a Paid Service; prompts and responses are not used to improve Google products and are processed under the applicable data processing terms.
The terms include region availability and 18+ eligibility restrictions for API use and API clients.
Data-use treatment for Gemini API depends on whether the Cloud project associated with API access has active billing.
Abuse monitoring and policy enforcement are distinct from product-improvement use.

local_change.change: Clarified that user question and retrieved evidence are sent to Gemini after consent; explained unpaid versus active-billing treatment in plain Thai; disclosed that the project's billing status was not verified; linked official terms and billing docs; avoided promising zero review/logging.

unresolved_owner_gates: The project owner has not confirmed the active billing status of the Google Cloud project linked to the deployment API key.
The target audience's age and geographic availability have not been reviewed against provider eligibility restrictions.
No approval has been recorded to send any restricted project evidence or user prompts to an external model.
limits: This review is not legal advice or a determination that project content is cleared for external processing.
